levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن محمد بن جمهور

notes: Leading «41 -» is a report number: left out. «جميعاً عن» makes the two co-transmitters one level (rule 2). «قالت لأبي جعفر» is written in the feminine as printed; the reading takes Abu al-Jarud as the asker, since he is the speaker. The Imam who answers closes the route (owner ruling 2).
